spans.text: CRITICAL: All scripts and commands executed via `terminal_run` MUST be non-interactive and designed to terminate automatically upon completion. Do not create persistent processes (e.g., web servers, background listeners) or commands that require user input.
spans.note: The prompt includes strong safety measures for tool and action execution.
